1_what_is_the_app: A conversational crypto analyst: create an Analyst (stored as a Lens), ask a question, and it researches live CoinMarketCap data in the same conversation.
2_funniest_or_most_impressive_claim: Voice: direct, specific, Tell → Clarify → Watch → Act → Return. Never claims real-time continuous observation; monitoring is periodic. Never calls itself a demo. Never invents market numbers. Quiet markets and missing data (not treated as zero) are valid outcomes. User-unnamed coins are not filled in as Bitcoin.
